methods.label: Use one common ratio unit
methods.explanation:
Represent the larger and smaller angle measures, in degrees, by \(5t\) and \(4t\). Because both angles are acute, \(0<t<18\). Their complements are \(90-5t\) and \(90-4t\).

The smaller angle has the larger complement, so the doubling condition must be
\[
90-4t=2(90-5t).
\]
Expanding and collecting terms gives
\[
90-4t=180-10t,
\qquad 6t=90,
\qquad t=15.
\]
The angles are \(75^\circ\) and \(60^\circ\), both acute, and their complements are \(15^\circ\) and \(30^\circ\), as required. Their sum is \(135^\circ\), choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
